{"script":"cat > /usr/local/bin/date-format <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if [ "$#" -lt 2 ]; then
  echo "Usage: date-format <date> <format>" >&2
  exit 2
fi
date_input="$1"
format="$2"
# Use GNU date to parse and format the input date
date -d "$date_input" +"$format"
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/date-format
# Verification
/usr/local/bin/date-format 2023-5-1 '%Y/%m/%d'"}
